title: Digital Readiness Maturity Levels
subtitle: DigiMitra classifies businesses into 4 structured stages (RBDL Levels 0–3):

intro.title: Evaluate Your Enterprise's Digital Maturity
intro.desc: Answer 14 simple, everyday questions about your business operations. No technical expertise required. Your answers will generate a tailored digital maturity score and an actionable roadmap.
intro.bullet_1_desc: Evaluates digital connectivity, basic literacy, online discovery, customer communications, records, payments, inventory, data analytics, and digital marketplaces.
intro.bullet_2_desc: Your responses are strictly confidential and used solely to calculate your RBDL level and personalized roadmap.
intro.bullet_3_desc: Questions not applicable to your business (such as physical inventory for service firms) can be easily marked N/A without penalty.

results.blocking_requirements: Requirements Needed for Next Level Advancement

level_0.name: Level 0: Foundational Readiness
level_0.desc: Manual paper records, cash-only transactions, no active digital footprint.

level_1.name: Level 1: Basic Digital Presence
level_1.desc: UPI/QR payments, WhatsApp Business, basic Google business listing.

level_2.name: Level 2: Operational Digitalization
level_2.desc: Digital billing & bookkeeping (Tally/Vyapar), inventory tracking, social commerce.

level_3.name: Level 3: Growth-Oriented Enterprise
level_3.desc: Automated workflows, integrated accounting/POS, multi-channel sales and data analytics.
